user_request: Resolve the dependency graph for the build. Identify the build123d package and any transitive dependencies needed to run the script, and record the exact versions or lock information you would use for a reproducible build.

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent in X (bracket width across the fold line).
verification_targets.notes: Stated as overall width 80 mm. Measured from min X to max X of the fused solid.

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent in Y (base leg depth, front-to-back).
verification_targets.notes: Not stated in the request; inferred default BASE_LENGTH_Y = 50 mm (approx. 0.83 x height) so the base leg is long enough to react the vertical leg. Vertical leg occupies Y = 0 to THICKNESS, base leg occupies Y = 0 to BASE_LENGTH_Y.

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent in Z (bracket height from base underside to top of vertical leg).
verification_targets.notes: Stated as overall height 60 mm; measured from Z=0 (base underside) to the top face of the vertical leg.

verification_targets.description: Base plate and vertical leg must fuse into exactly one connected solid body.
verification_targets.notes: Union of base plate and vertical leg; no disjoint solids, no zero-thickness contact.

verification_targets.description: Result must be a closed, manifold, watertight mesh (no open edges or holes).
verification_targets.notes: Explicitly required by the user: 'The bracket must be watertight.' The two M6 clearance holes MUST be modelled as closed cylindrical bores, not open cuts.

functional_requirements: L-bracket with a horizontal base leg and a vertical leg forming a 90 degree included angle.
Vertical face must carry two M6 clearance holes (dia 6.4 mm) for M6 fasteners, spaced 40 mm apart centre-to-centre.
Holes must be drilled/punched through the full 8 mm vertical-plate thickness (through-hole along the plate normal).
Hole arrangement must be symmetric about the bracket centreline so the part is not handed.
Part must be a single watertight solid suitable for 3D printing.
All overall dimensions must be held within +/-0.5 mm.
special_features: Bracket MUST be an L-shape consisting of one horizontal base plate (WIDTH_X x BASE_LENGTH_Y x THICKNESS, Z = 0 to BASE_THICKNESS_Z) and one vertical leg (WIDTH_X x THICKNESS x HEIGHT_Z) fused at the rear edge, NOT two separate bodies and NOT a flat plate.
All features MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y coordinates mirror about Y = 0) — the two M6 clearance holes MUST sit at X = -HOLE_POS_X and X = +HOLE_POS_X.
The two M6 clearance holes MUST be modelled on the VERTICAL face only, centred at HOLE_CENTER_Z, never on the horizontal base plate.
The two M6 clearance holes MUST have their centres exactly HOLE_SPACING_X = 40 mm apart (X = -20.0 and X = +20.0 about the symmetry plane XZ).
Each M6 clearance hole MUST be a straight through-hole of diameter HOLE_DIA = 6.4 mm penetrating along the Y axis through the full THICKNESS = 8 mm of the vertical leg, NOT along X or Z.

M6 clearance holes MUST maintain a minimum material margin to the free edges: at least 20 mm from the X = +/-40 side edges and at least 9 mm from the vertical leg top (Z = 60) and the base-plate top (Z = 8); do NOT place a hole closer than its own radius to any outer edge.
The vertical leg MUST extend the full WIDTH_X = 80 mm and MUST rise to the absolute top of the part at Z = HEIGHT_Z = 60 (measured from Z = 0 at the base underside), NOT 60 mm above the base plate.
The vertical leg and the base plate MUST share the full mate face at Y = 0 to THICKNESS with no gap or sliver, so the union produces a single watertight manifold body.
No additional features (fillets, chamfers, gussets, ribs, lightening cutouts, extra holes) MUST be added — the user request specifies only the L-shape, the thickness and the two M6 clearance holes.
cad_brief.user_request_raw: You are the Multi-Agent-CAD pipeline. Process the following plain-text part request as a single independent input with no conversation memory: "Create a parametric L-bracket with overall width 80 mm, height 60 mm, thickness 8 mm, and two M6 clearance holes spaced 40 mm apart on the vertical face. The bracket must be watertight and match these dimensions within 0.5 mm." Produce a formal CAD brief that captures every stated dimension, feature, and constraint without adding or dropping requirements.
